cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd only be peeling apples. Could you keep Mum in the kitchen for twenty minutes while I hide her birthday cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you stop telling her I'm the one who plans these things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do the explaining afterwards. Ask her for the pastry lesson; I'll bring the cake in once she's got flour on her hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll have the apples sliced before you start. Ask for the lattice top; that gives me time to hide the candles too. You can let me do the washing-up.
